TWO BUGS FOUND THAT LIKELY AFFECT OTHER BOARDS:
1. `font:` SHORTHAND + var() SILENTLY DROPS line-height. `font:700 var(--t-x)/1 var(--font-y),...` parsed the family correctly but computed line-height as `normal`, which broke every auto-fit height measurement (boxes read 26% taller than designed). Converted all 20 shorthands in this file to longhands. Any board using this pattern has the same latent bug.
2. THE TAURUS GATE MATCHES PROSE. A CSS comment reading "No `inset:` shorthand anywhere (Taurus gate)" matches check-taurus-safety.cjs's /\binset:\s*[^,;{}\n]+/ and would have failed CI on a file with zero real violations. Reworded; `node apps/web/tools/check-taurus-safety.cjs` now returns OK (171 files, within baseline) and a raw grep for inset:/inset-N returns nothing.

AUTO-FIT: the fitter measures WIDTH ONLY for single-line boxes (white-space:nowrap/pre, or data-fit="single"). A glyph's font content area is taller than a sub-1 line-height, so scrollHeight always exceeds the line box and a height check would shrink perfectly good one-liners toward the 50px floor. Wrapping blocks still get both axes. Floor is 50px; measured minimum across both orientations is exactly 50px (the mono micro-labels), body copy 64px, deal names 66-96px, hero 480-520px.

THEME DUAL-WRITE: applyTheme emits a `:root{...}` rule into a runtime <style> tag rather than writing documentElement.style. That is deliberate — the V5 shim writes its brand to documentElement inline style, and inline beats a stylesheet :root rule, so an operator's shim brand correctly wins over the template's theme defaults while the theme block still drives everything when no shim brand is set. Both paths verified visually, not just by computed value.

TWO REAL BUGS FOUND AND FIXED DURING SELF-VERIFY, both worth knowing for the other boards in this batch:
1. My first overflows() checked scrollHeight on data-fit="single" elements. Bodoni Moda and Oswald have tall vertical metrics, so their line box exceeds line-height:1 and every single-line headline reported "overflow" and was binary-searched down to the 50px floor — the board title rendered at 50px instead of 150px. Single-line roles now measure width only (matches the documented flagship engine).
2. .fnote was display:flex; align-items:center. A flex-centred overflow is NOT reflected in scrollHeight, so the fit engine reported "fits" while the third line was visibly clipped in the render. All multi-line fit boxes are now display:block so the height check is honest. A width/height-only DOM probe would have missed this; it was caught by eyeballing the screenshot.

SCHEDULE ENGINE DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED (flagging since FLAGSHIP-STANDARDS §4a reads broadly): "Tables Tonight" is a reservation roster, not a bell/period rotation. Its times live inside t.N.size as "6 · 9:00 PM", which parseMin would read as 09:00 AM (h>=7 so no PM promotion), and the engine's status writer would overwrite operator-authored t.N.at text ("Booth 4 · arrived"). Row states stay static via data-state="in|next|open". The date engine is also not used (no dated/weekly content); the live clock IS wired (data-live="clock", 15s tick, data-pin respected).

IMAGE SLOTS: board.bg (full-bleed, CSS light-beam art default), brand.logo (foil medallion + brand.mark monogram), pkg.0/1/2.img (magnum + sparkler CSS art).
